articles.title: EU reveals it suffered 'AI-powered' cyber attack
articles.summary: The EU has revealed it suffered a cyber attack powered by AI last month and some of its digital tools are still offline as a result.

articles.title: Burnham says Europe 'ready to enter negotiations' to help end Russia's war in Ukraine
articles.summary: Europe is ready to enter negotiations to help end Russia's war in Ukraine, Andy Burnham has said.

articles.title: UEFA challenges FIFA over access to Infantino World Cup sell-off papers - as presidency rivals revealed
articles.summary: FIFA has confirmed which candidates will stand in next year's presidential election - as UEFA challenges restrictions placed on documents relating to the World Cup sell-off scandal.

articles.title: Muslims projected to outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035
articles.summary: Islam is expected to surpass Christianity as the world's largest religion by 2035, according to detailed projections released on Wednesday.

articles.title: Israeli troops launch ground operation in central Gaza
articles.summary: Dozens of displaced Palestinians have fled their tents and shelters in central ‌Gaza after Israel launched a rare ground operation in an area it had left under a ceasefire last year.

articles.title: William and Kate meet India's PM as they wrap up royal visit
articles.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales met the prime minister of India on Wednesday to discuss trade and bilateral ‌ties at the end of their three-day visit to the country.
